senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to circle, v. קַו,] to cave or heap up, gather. Part. pass. קָווּי.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:6:6">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵈ</cite> <he>ואפי׳ ק׳ לתוך ידו</he> even when the oil is held in the hollow of his hand.

senses.gloss: to gather, to conduct water courses into a common bed. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ bot. דוקל׳ ה׳ נהרות ועשאו Diocletian united several rivers and made it (the bay of Emesa); Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV (corr. acc.), v. חֲמָץ.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:12">Num. R. s. 13</cite> <he>כשה׳ הקב״ה וכ׳</he> when the Lord, on the third day of creation, gathered all the waters in one place; a. e.

senses.gloss: to add to the capacity of a bath.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shekalim 1:2">Tosef. Shek. I, 2</cite> <he>כל מקוה … כשר להַקְווֹת עליו</he> a bath which has the (legally required) capacity of forty S’ah is fit to be added to (by carrying water into it in vessels).
<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 3:6">Tosef. Mikv. III, 6</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to look out (cmp. קַוָּא a. כַּוָּוא) to wait, hope.
units: Gen. R. s. 5 (play on יִקָּווּ, Gen. I, 9) יְקַוּוּ לי המים מה וכ׳ let the waters look out for me (to see) what I shall do &c.; ib. s. 28; Lam. R. to I, 17; Yalk. Gen. 7; Yalk. Ps. 848; [perh. to be read יִקָּווּ Nif.].

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 6:1-4">Midr. Till. to Ps. VI</cite> <he>והיה … מְקַוֶּה לרופא וכ׳</he> and the patient anxiously waited for the physician (asking), when will he come? &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 635">Yalk. ib. 635</cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:3">Cant. R. to II, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00309">next w.</cite>; a. fr.
